<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_slot(fr, r0, r1, c0base, i):
    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c0=c0base+7*i
    g=[['B' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+7)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if 'B' in row]
    cs=[j for row in g for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='B']
    r0b,r1b,c0b,c1b=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(tuple('B' if g[i][j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(c0b,c1b+1)) for i in range(r0b,r1b+1))
def show(s): return ' '.join(''.join(r) for r in s)
def boxes(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']
            out.append((min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b)))
    return sorted(out)
print("boxes:",boxes(current_frame))
bs0=get_slot(current_frame,40,47,14,0); ps0=get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,0)
print("before blue s0:",show(bs0)); print("before pink s0:",show(ps0))
action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN boxes:",boxes(current_frame))
print("blue s0 changed:",get_slot(current_frame,40,47,14,0)!=bs0, show(get_slot(current_frame,40,47,14,0)))
print("pink s0 changed:",get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,0)!=ps0, show(get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,0)))
action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN2 boxes:",boxes(current_frame))
print("blue s0 changed:",get_slot(current_frame,40,47,14,0)!=get_slot(previous_frame,40,47,14,0), show(get_slot(current_frame,40,47,14,0)))
print("pink s0 changed:",get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,0)!=get_slot(previous_frame,51,58,14,0), show(get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,0)))
</parameter>

    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
